title: West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Punjab Amendment Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Punjab Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT III OF 1973
ACT III OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
MOTOR VEHICLES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to further
amend the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance,
1965 (West
Pakistan Ordinance XIX of 1965), in its application to the Province of the
Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 26th February 1973]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of the Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 26th February 1973).
No. PAP -Legis-2(6)/73/39.----The
West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of February 1973 and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 24th day of February 1973, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Punjab.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles
(Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall extend to the whole
of the Province of the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Substitution of Punjab Road Transport Board for Road Transport Corporation

ACT III OF 1973
ACT III OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
MOTOR VEHICLES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to further
amend the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance,
1965 (West
Pakistan Ordinance XIX of 1965), in its application to the Province of the
Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 26th February 1973]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of the Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 26th February 1973).
No. PAP -Legis-2(6)/73/39.----The
West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of February 1973 and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 24th day of February 1973, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Punjab.
2. Substitution of Punjab Road
Transport Board for Road Transport Corporation.-----In the West Pakistan
Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (West Pakistan Ordinance XIX of 1965), in its
application to the Province of the Punjab, hereinafter referred to as the
principal Ordinance and in any rules framed thereunder----
(a) for the words 'Road Transport
Corporation' wherever occurring, the words 'Punjab Road Transport Board' ; and
(b) for the word 'Corporation'
wherever occurring, the word 'Board' shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 70 of West Pakistan Ordinance XIX of 1965

No. PAP -Legis-2(6)/73/39.----The
West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of February 1973 and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 24th day of February 1973, is

3. Amendment of section 70 of
West Pakistan Ordinance XIX of 1965.-In the principal Ordinance, in section
70-
(i) in subsection (2), for the
words "a Chairman and two", the words seven shall be substituted ;
and after the word "Government" the following shall be added :--
"and shall be constituted as
follows :-
1. Minister incharge ...
Chairman.
2. One nominee of the Provincial
Assembly ...
Member.
3. One representative of any
Bargaining Agent of Road
Transport Board Workers' Union or
Federation ...
Member.
4. A representative of Technical
Branch of Punjab Road
Transport Board ...
Member.
5. A representative of Traffic
Branch of Punjab Road
Transport Board ...
Member.
6. A representative of other
modes of public transport ... Member.
7. Managing Director of Punjab
Road Transport
Board Member.";
(ii) for subsection (3), the
following shall be substituted, namely ;-
"(3) The tern of office of
each individual member shall be such as may be determined by Government at the
time of his appointment." ;
(iii) in subsection (4), the
words 'the Chairman or' shall be deleted;
(iv) in subsection (5), for the
words 'the Chairman or any', the word 'Any' shall be substituted ;
(v) in subsection (6), for the
words "The Chairman and each", the word "Each" shall be
substituted ; and for the word "shall" occurring between the words
"member" and "receive", the word "may" shall be
substituted ; and for the word "and" occurring between the words
"salary" and "allowances", the word "or" shall be
substituted;
(vi) in subsection (7)-
(a) the words 'the Chairman or'
shall be deleted ; and
(b) after clause (iv), the
following new clauses shall be added, namely :--
"(v) if he absents himself
from two consecutive meetings of the Board without leave of absence ; or
(vi) if he is found to be a
lunatic or is of unsound mind.".

4. Corporation to continue
till the establishment of the Board.-----Not withstanding the amendments
made by this Act, the Road Transport Corporation (hereinafter referred to as
the Corporation) shall, until the Road Transport Board (hereinafter referred to
as the Board) is established, continue to function as if this Act had not been
made.
